channel.title: du xiang
channel.description: machine learning, production systems, and other small obsessions. full-text essays, no tracking, dotted borders.

item.title: On Feeling Weak · 关于无力感
item.description: Twenty years of learning, four years of acceleration, and the question of what remains ours. A personal essay, written late at night, in both my languages.

item.title: Agent Teams vs Sub-Agents: Multi-Agent Architectures for LLMs
item.description: AI agents that talk to each other, peer-to-peer. How that compares to hub-and-spoke sub-agents, and when each one earns its complexity.

item.title: Skills vs MCP: Tool Architecture for AI Agents
item.description: How should a machine hold its tools? Enterprise cases, security considerations, and some opinions.

item.title: Context Engineering: Building Intelligent Memory Systems
item.description: Giving language models a memory, so they stop forgetting you between conversations. From short-term buffers to knowledge graphs.

item.title: Scaling SEO & GEO Content with LLMs
item.description: Teaching machines to write things other machines want to read. The circle of life, automated.

item.title: Real-Time Personalized Quick Suggest with WebSockets
item.description: Autocomplete fast enough to finish your sentence politely. FAISS, WebSockets, FastAPI.

item.title: Hot-Swappable LoRA: Serving 16 Models on One GPU
item.description: Sixteen fine-tuned models sharing one graphics card, like graduate students sharing an apartment. vLLM, PEFT, SageMaker.

item.title: Latent Reasoning: Teaching Small LLMs to Think Without Thinking
item.description: Chain-of-thought quality without the token toll. Small models, larger ambitions.

item.title: Lipstick Recommendation
item.description: Data science applied to Taobao lipstick trends. Off-site, and in Chinese.

item.title: Earthquake Analysis
item.description: Web-crawled earthquake data with heatmap visualization. Off-site, and in Chinese.
